newsitem.title: USA: Hunt Oil holds 8.05 pct Key Energy stake.
newsitem.headline: Hunt Oil holds 8.05 pct Key Energy stake.

text.p: Hunt Oil Co said Monday it holds an 8.05 percent stake, or 917,500 common shares, in Key Energy Group Inc.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Hunt, a private oil and natural gas company controlled by the Hunt family of Texas, said it acquired the shares when its unit, Brooks Well Servicing Inc, merged with WellTech Eastern Inc, a unit of Key Energy, on November 22.
WellTech was the surviving corporation in the merger. As part of the merger, Brooks' shares held by Hunt were converted into 917,500 common shares of Key Energy.
Hunt said it holds the stake in Key Energy for investment purposes.
